children: Elmet Group entered into a Warrant Purchase Agreement with Blue Moon Metals, issuing an unregistered warrant to buy up to 1,166,970 common shares at $21.423 per share. The warrant becomes exercisable six months after issuance, expires three years from issuance, and includes a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap adjustable up to 19.99%. It may be exercised on a cashless basis if no effective resale registration is available. The issuance was made in consideration of Blue Moon’s investment and obligations under a prior letter agreement.
